# The Keeping of Small Things

For thirty-one years, Elias Voss had climbed the one hundred and twelve iron steps each evening to light the lamp at Kettle Point Lighthouse. His hands knew every groove in the railing before his eyes did. The wind off the North Sea never varied much—salt and cold and the low groan of water finding
